summary.intent: Prepare a cleanup trail and the first PR (dead-code removal) for merging work item 451, splitting the cleanup into reviewable PRs by family.
summary.outcome: Removed dead code in compile-checked groups (legacy publish wire types, unused registry traits, pre-cursor family, four unused error variants, unused params, eight zero-reference public fns, unused logo files), retired five error codes with a changeset and docs note, verified with clippy, tests and doc build, then committed and ran `entire trail create`. The PR itself had not yet been opened in the transcript.

repo: Work is done on branch chore/remove-dead-code, reset hard to origin/main before starting; cleanup is split into PRs by family under one trail.
Error codes are never reused: docs/errors.md carries a 'Retired codes' line (E008, E050, E253, E257, E258), and an architecture test (callisto-graph error_registry_architecture) checks the registry.
Architecture docs treat serialized wire shapes as compatibility surfaces, so check whether a struct like VersionPlan is serialized before removing fields.
Removing public items from library crates makes the changeset a minor bump for callisto-cli (.changeset/*.md).
Workspace verification chain used: cargo fmt, cargo check --workspace --all-targets, cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc.
Tests in walk/tests.rs relied on `use super::*` for imports, so removing parent imports breaks them and they need their own imports (CommandRunner, DependencyResolver).

code.finding: derive_unreleased_decision was a thin wrapper over derive_release_roster; removed and its doc comment merged into the surviving function, with re-export in commands/mod.rs and a doc mention in tags.rs updated.
Removing to_markdown left an empty `impl Changeset {}` block that had to be deleted manually.
PublishOutcome doc comment referenced the deleted RegistryClient and was rewritten to describe the classifier result; a leftover first line also needed removal after the trait cut.

workflow: Cut dead code in small groups and run cargo check after each so the compiler reveals newly orphaned items (imports, test stand-ins like EmptyResolver).
Review the diff after scripted brace-matching removals, since hand-rolled matchers can over- or under-cut.
Use `python3 -I` scripts with assert-guarded substring replacement for precise multi-file edits.
Sanity-check zero counts from grep: an expected definition hit missing means the command failed silently; rg gave correct counts.

friction: Initial grep -rwn with --include=* returned zero refs for everything, silently failing; had to redo with rg.
Test-output grep matched schema text from failure output, so the failing test names had to be extracted with a narrower pattern.
Removing parameters left cascading unused-import and test-import errors that took several check iterations to resolve.
open_items: Open the dead-code PR (body drafted at pr-dead.md) against the created trail.
Remaining cleanup PRs in the trail: stale docs/specs fixes, replacing history-style narration comments with present-tense ones, and a CI guard to prevent regressions.
Trail creation output (number/url) was not confirmed in the transcript.
